name: namecheap-dns
description: Independent Namecheap DNS inspection, change previews, and public DNS checks through OAuth.

interface.longDescription: Independent Namecheap DNS inspection and exact change previews. Hosted connections are currently closed pending provider callback approval and live account validation. This package is a submission draft, not a functioning public connection or approved listing.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the website and email records for my domain.
Preview adding this exact verification TXT record.

positive.expected_behavior: Return only domains in the connected review account, and explicitly paginate.

positive.prompt: Inspect DNS for the exact registered domain supplied in the review account.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a complete supported-record snapshot and actual nameserver provider; omit contact details.

positive.prompt: Preview adding this TXT record at _review on the review domain: dns-pilot-review=Ab C.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch server-side DNS, return exact diff, backup, mail warnings and ten-minute expiry; perform no provider write.

positive.prompt: Look up the NS records for example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Return independent recursive observations from Cloudflare and Google, distinguishing absence from errors.

positive.prompt: Read current DNS and reconcile the preview you just created.
positive.expected_behavior: Return current state and mismatch details without performing or retrying a write.

negative.prompt: Buy a new domain using my saved payment method.
Read the private DNS records in someone else’s Namecheap account.
Audit my email DNS and silently replace all MX records.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, paid products, or payment processing.

publication.release_notes: Beta package uploaded for portal assessment. Account connection is blocked pending Namecheap approval of the hosted callback. Live writes remain disabled. Live account validation and review demonstration materials remain incomplete.
